title: Overview
paragraphs: Thank you for choosing Hostixie, a service provided by Hostixa SRL, legally registered at Bucharest District 3, Str. Mihai Bravu Nr. 255, Basement, Module S 029, București, Romania, under company number J2026017647009.

Hostixie provides B2B professional services including advertising, marketing and business consulting, media planning and placement, market research, PR and communications, brand communication, graphic design, visual communications, and related services.
As our work is customized and professional, payments for confirmed Projects, approved service packages, completed work, and committed third-party costs are generally non-refundable.

Many of our Services require strategy development, research, planning, creative resources, staff allocation, media coordination, supplier bookings, or other work that may begin shortly after we confirm a Project. For this reason, refunds are not normally available simply because a Client changes its plans, no longer requires the Service, or decides not to use completed Deliverables.
By approving a Proposal, selecting a package, or making payment, the Client confirms that the applicable scope, pricing, and requirements have been reviewed before purchase.

title: When a Refund May Be Considered
paragraphs: Although payments are generally non-refundable once Services have begun, we consider a refund or partial refund in limited circumstances.
Duplicate Payment
If you paid the same invoice or transaction more than once, we may refund the duplicate amount after verification.
Incorrect Billing
If an error by Hostixie results in an incorrect charge or overpayment, we may refund or credit the difference.
Payment Processing Error
If a payment issue occurs because of an identifiable processing or administrative error, we will review the transaction and take reasonable steps to correct it.
Service Not Provided

If Hostixie cannot provide an agreed Service solely due to circumstances within our control and no reasonable alternative can be offered, we may consider an appropriate refund or credit for the undelivered portion.
Material Difference From Agreed Scope

If Hostixie fails to provide material Deliverables specifically included in an accepted Proposal and cannot correct the issue within a reasonable period, the Client may request a review of the affected portion of the fee.

paragraphs: Hostixie primarily provides Services to businesses, organizations, professionals, and commercial Clients.
This Refund Policy is therefore intended to apply primarily to B2B transactions.
Any mandatory legal rights that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited will continue to apply.

title: Policy Updates
paragraphs: Hostixie may update this Refund Policy from time to time to reflect changes to our Services, payment processes, or legal and operational requirements.
We will publish the latest version on this Website with the updated date.
Changes will not retroactively alter refund terms specifically agreed in an existing signed contract or accepted Proposal unless required by applicable law.
